title: MV/MZ Changing Enemy SV Sprite s Based on their HP? (Using VisuStella)

posts.author: Maysa
posts.body:
Hello Everyone!
I'm tinkering a bit with the visuals for RPG Maker sideview battles and i'm trying out some ideas.
I got a plugin that changes an actor’s SV sprite based on their HP, and it works well.
Now I want to do the same for enemies and noticed that VisuStella's plugin allows enemies to use player sprites.
Is there a way to make enemy sprites change based on HP with VisuStella?
If not, is there any other method or workaround I could try?
Also:
Not sure if I should make a separate post for this — but I saw a front-view battle setup where you see the backs of the characters at a slight angle, and they change image when casting or attacking.
Does anyone know a plugin for this kind of setup?
Thank you!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Try and change the enemy sprite with a script like:
$gameTroop.members()[0]._svBattlerData.name = "Actor1_1"
Then you can go to Battle Core mechanics settings and set the general 'Post-Damage' setting to check
if (target.isEnemy())
check the
hpRate()
and make it read filenames from the enemy meta notetags to change it.
EDIT: If you don't use all the motions, you can also replace some with the damaged motions and use states and state notetags that dictate the motion to use.
